correctness.rationale: Proof reconstructs the exact Sp4-equivariant surface-incidence gluing for A_2[p] from arxiv:2609.14895v1. Nonidentity transvection fixes (p^3-1)/2 signed vertices, c=(p²-1)/2 wedge-decorated Lagrangian surfaces, c² incidence edges; it acts identically on each fixed surface. Equivariant Mayer–Vietoris and the cellular graph exact sequence give traces; rational C_p representation theory yields multiplicities. These are all-prime arguments, checked independently by finite-field enumeration at p=3,5,7 with standalone code.

value.rationale: Transvections are natural symplectic monodromy generators. Uniform exact cyclic eigenmultiplicities on rational weight-zero cohomology across all odd prime Siegel levels refine the previously known nonequivariant Betti counts, determine invariant-subspace dimensions, and may serve as benchmarks for deeper finite symplectic representation problems. This is not a finite isolated computation.
